latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Provides comprehensive coaching for founders preparing for live VC or investor pitch meetings.

- Covers pre-meeting research on partners, firms, and competitive landscapes.
- Details the full 30-minute meeting structure, including opening, narrative, demo, Q&A, and closing.
- Guides on live-room dynamics: identifying decision-makers, reading partner/principal/analyst signals.
- Prepares founders for typical "kill questions" and handling tough Q&A.
- Teaches how to read interest vs. polite-no signals in real time.
- Advises on post-meeting follow-up and preparing for second/partner meetings.
- Clear triggers for when to engage and when to use alternative skills.
